Best of Times, Worst of Times: Record Fossil Fuel Profits, Inflation and Inequality
abstract: The 2022 oil and gas crisis resulted in record fossil-fuel profits globally that rehabilitated the oil and gas industry, obstructed the energy transition and contributed to inflation, but their magnitude and beneficiaries have been insufficiently understood. Here we show the size of profits across countries and their distribution across socio-economic groups within the United States, using company income statements, comprehensive ownership data and a network model for propagating profits via shareholdings. We estimate that globally, net income in publicly listed oil and gas companies alone reached US$916 billion in 2022, with the United States the biggest beneficiary with claims on US$301 billion, more than U.S. investments of US$267 billion in the low carbon economy that year. In a network of U.S. shareholdings with 252,433 nodes including privately held U.S. companies, 50 % of profits went to the wealthiest 1 % of individuals, predominantly through direct shareholdings and private company ownership. In contrast the bottom 50 % only received 1 %. The incremental U.S. fossil-fuel profits in 2022 relative to 2021 were enough to increase the disposable income of the wealthiest Americans by several percent and compensate a substantial part of their purchasing power loss from inflation that year, thereby exacerbating inflation inequality. These profits also reinforced existing racial and ethnic inequalities and inequalities between groups with different educational attainments. We discuss how an excess profit tax could be used to both lower inequality and accelerate the energy transition as increasing geopolitical tensions and climate impacts threaten continued volatility in oil and gas markets.
abstract_zh: 2022年的石油和天然气危机使全球化石燃料利润创下纪录，帮助石油和天然气行业恢复元气，阻碍了能源转型，并推高了通货膨胀，但其规模及受益者一直未被充分理解。在此，我们利用公司损益表、全面的所有权数据以及通过股权持有传导利润的网络模型，展示了各国利润的规模，以及这些利润在美国各社会经济群体中的分布。我们估计，仅全球上市石油和天然气公司的净收入在2022年就达到9160亿美元，其中美国是最大受益者，获得了3010亿美元的收益，超过了当年美国对低碳经济2670亿美元的投资额。在一个包含252,433个节点（含美国私营企业）的美国股权网络中，50%的利润流向了最富有的1%的个人，主要通过直接持股和私营企业所有权实现。相比之下，底部50%的人仅获得1%。与2021年相比，2022年美国化石燃料利润的增量足以使最富有美国人的可支配收入增加数个百分点，并弥补他们因当年通货膨胀而损失的大部分购买力，从而加剧了通胀不平等。这些利润还强化了既有的种族和民族不平等，以及不同教育程度群体之间的不平等。我们讨论了超额利润税如何既能降低不平等，又能加速能源转型，因为日益加剧的地缘政治紧张和气候影响，威胁着石油和天然气市场持续的波动。

title: Stranded Fossil-Fuel Assets Translate to Major Losses for Investors in Advanced Economies
abstract: The distribution of ownership of transition risk associated with stranded fossil-fuel assets remains poorly understood. We calculate that global stranded assets as present value of future lost profits in the upstream oil and gas sector exceed US$1 trillion under plausible changes in expectations about the effects of climate policy. We trace the equity risk ownership from 43,439 oil and gas production assets through a global equity network of 1.8 million companies to their ultimate owners. Most of the market risk falls on private investors, overwhelmingly in OECD countries, including substantial exposure through pension funds and financial markets. The ownership distribution reveals an international net transfer of more than 15% of global stranded asset risk to OECD-based investors. Rich country stakeholders therefore have a major stake in how the transition in oil and gas production is managed, as ongoing supporters of the fossil-fuel economy and potentially exposed owners of stranded assets.
abstract_zh: 与搁浅的化石燃料资产相关的转型风险的所有权分布仍然鲜为人知。在气候政策效果预期发生合理变化的情形下，我们测算出全球搁浅资产（以上游石油和天然气部门未来损失利润的现值计）超过1万亿美元。我们将43,439个石油和天然气生产资产的股权风险，追溯到由180万家公司构成的全球股权网络中的最终所有者。大部分市场风险由私人投资者承担，且主要位于经合组织（OECD）国家，包括通过养老基金和金融市场所产生的大量敞口。所有权分布显示，全球搁浅资产风险中超过15%通过国际净转移落到了经合组织国家的投资者身上。因此，富裕国家的利益相关者对石油和天然气生产转型的管理方式有重大利害关系，他们既是化石燃料经济的持续支持者，也是潜在的搁浅资产暴露所有者。

title: Do Firms With Higher Energy Efficiency Have Better Access to Finance?
Energy Efficiency and Economy-Wide Rebound Effects: A Review of the Evidence and Its Implications
abstract: The majority of global energy scenarios anticipate a structural break in the relationship between energy consumption and gross domestic product (GDP), with several scenarios projecting absolute decoupling, where energy use falls while GDP continues to grow. However, there are few precedents for absolute decoupling, and current global trends are in the opposite direction. This paper explores one possible explanation for the historical close relationship between energy consumption and GDP, namely that the economy-wide rebound effects from improved energy efficiency are larger than is commonly assumed. We review the evidence on the size of economy-wide rebound effects and explore whether and how such effects are taken into account within the models used to produce global energy scenarios. We find the evidence base to be growing in size and quality, but remarkably diverse in terms of the methodologies employed, assumptions used, and rebound mechanisms included. Despite this diversity, the results are broadly consistent and suggest that economy-wide rebound effects may erode more than half of the expected energy savings from improved energy efficiency. We also find that many of the mechanisms driving rebound effects are overlooked by integrated assessment and global energy models. We therefore conclude that global energy scenarios may underestimate the future rate of growth of global energy demand.
abstract_zh: 全球能源情景的大多数假设预期，能源消费与国内生产总值（GDP）之间的关系将发生结构性断裂，其中若干情景预测将出现绝对脱钩，即能源使用下降而GDP继续增长。然而，绝对脱钩的先例很少，且当前全球趋势恰恰相反。本文探讨了能源消费与GDP历史上密切关系的一种可能解释，即能效改善所引发的全经济范围回弹效应（rebound effects）比通常假设的要大。我们回顾了关于全经济范围回弹效应规模的证据，并探讨了此类效应是否以及如何被纳入用于编制全球能源情景的模型之中。我们发现，证据基础的规模和质量都在增长，但在所采用的方法、假设以及所包含的回弹机制方面却极为多样。尽管存在这种多样性，结果总体上是一致的，并表明全经济范围的回弹效应可能会抵消能效改善带来的预期节能量中的一半以上。我们还发现，许多驱动回弹效应的机制被综合评估模型和全球能源模型所忽视。因此，我们认为，全球能源情景可能低估了未来全球能源需求的增长速度。

title: Low-Carbon Transition Risks for Finance
Plausible Energy Demand Patterns in a Growing Global Economy with Climate Policy
Reframing Incentives for Climate Policy Action
abstract: A key aim of climate policy is to progressively substitute renewables and energy efficiency for fossil fuel use. The associated rapid depreciation and replacement of fossil fuel-related physical and natural capital may entail a profound reorganisation of industry value chains, international trade, and geopolitics. Here, we present evidence confirming that the transformation of energy systems is well under way, and we explore the economic and strategic implications of the emerging energy geography. We show specifically that, given the economic implications of the ongoing energy transformation, the framing of climate policy as a prisoner’s dilemma is a poor description of strategic incentives. Instead, a new climate policy game emerges in which fossil fuel importers are better off decarbonising, competitive fossil fuel exporters are better off flooding markets, and uncompetitive fossil fuel producers – rather than benefitting from ‘free-riding’ – suffer from their exposure to stranded assets and lack of investment in decarbonisation technologies.
abstract_zh: 气候政策的一个核心目标，是逐步以可再生能源和能源效率替代化石燃料的使用。与之相伴的化石燃料相关实物资本和自然资本的快速折旧与更替，可能引发产业价值链、国际贸易和地缘政治的深刻重组。在此，我们提供证据表明，能源系统的转型已在进行之中，并探讨新兴能源地理格局的经济与战略含义。我们具体表明，鉴于正在进行的能源转型所带来的经济影响，将气候政策视为囚徒困境并不能很好地描述战略激励。相反，一种新的气候政策博弈正在形成：化石燃料进口国通过脱碳而境况更好，具有竞争力的化石燃料出口国则通过向市场倾销而境况更好，而缺乏竞争力的化石燃料生产者——非但不能从“搭便车”中获益——还会因其在搁浅资产上的暴露以及在脱碳技术上的投资不足而受损。

title: Financing Green Growth
venue: Book chapter in Handbook on Green Growth
abstract: This chapter surveys the current state of financing green growth in the energy sector, based on the insight that there are different qualities of finance. In past transformational changes in other sectors, public monies played a key role across the innovation landscape. Public financing was central also in a number of past national energy transitions, as reviewed here for Iceland (from fossil to geothermal energy), Norway (from mainly non-electricity energy to hydroelectricity), France (from oil to nuclear) and the United States (from conventional to shale gas). In the current transition to low-carbon energy supplies, there is much public activity, most directed and concerted in China, but also reasons to doubt it is enough and applied in the right places to be able to finance the transition to a low carbon sector on timescales consistent with current climate change mitigation targets. A discussion of opportunities and challenges to a more central role for public financing concludes, drawing also on insights from the recent mission-oriented innovation literature.
abstract_zh: 本章基于“融资存在不同质量”的观点，考察能源部门绿色增长融资的现状。在过去其他部门的转型变革中，公共资金在整个创新格局中发挥了关键作用。在一些国家过去的能源转型中，公共融资也是核心，本文回顾了冰岛（从化石能源转向地热能）、挪威（从以非电力能源为主转向水电）、法国（从石油转向核能）以及美国（从常规天然气转向页岩气）的案例。在当前向低碳能源供应转型的过程中，公共活动很多，在中国最为集中、最具指向性，但仍有理由怀疑，这些活动是否足以、且是否被用于正确的领域，以便在符合当前气候变化减缓目标的时间尺度上为向低碳部门转型提供资金。本章最后讨论了公共融资发挥更核心作用的机遇与挑战，并借鉴了近期使命导向型创新文献的见解。

title: Financing Renewable Energy: Who Is Financing What, and Why It Matters
abstract: Successful financing of innovation in renewable energy (RE) requires a better understanding of the relationship between different types of finance and their willingness to invest in RE. We study the ‘direction’ of innovation that financial actors create. Focusing on the deployment phase of innovation, we use Bloomberg New Energy Finance (BNEF) data to construct a global dataset of RE asset finance flows from 2004 to 2014. We analyze the asset portfolios of different RE technologies financed by different financial actors according to their size, skew and level of risk. We use entropy-based indices to measure skew, and construct a heuristic index of risk that varies with the technology, time, and country of investment to measure risk. We start by comparing the behavior of private and public types of finance and then disaggregate further along 11 different financial actors (e.g. private banks, public banks, and utilities) and 11 types of RE technologies that are invested in (e.g. different kinds of power generation from solar radiation, wind or biomass). Financial actors vary considerably in the composition of their investment portfolio, creating directions towards particular technologies. Public financial actors invest in portfolios with higher risk technologies, also creating a direction; they also increased their share in total investment dramatically over time. We use these preliminary results to formulate new research questions about how finance affects the directionality of innovation, and the implications for RE policies.
abstract_zh: 要成功为可再生能源（RE）创新提供融资，需要更好地理解不同类型的融资及其投资可再生能源的意愿之间的关系。我们研究金融行为体所形成的创新“方向”。聚焦于创新的部署阶段，我们利用彭博新能源财经（BNEF）数据，构建了2004年至2014年全球可再生能源资产融资流量的数据集。我们按规模、偏度和风险水平，分析了不同金融行为体所融资的不同可再生能源技术的资产组合。我们使用基于熵的指数衡量偏度，并构建了一个启发式风险指数，该指数随技术、时间和投资国别而变化，用以衡量风险。我们首先比较私人融资与公共融资的行为，然后进一步按11类金融行为体（如私营银行、公共银行和公用事业公司）以及11类被投资的可再生能源技术（如来自太阳辐射、风能或生物质的不同发电类型）进行细分。金融行为体在投资组合构成上差异显著，形成了指向特定技术的创新方向。公共金融行为体投资于风险较高技术的组合，也因此形成了一种方向；并且随着时间推移，其在总投资中的份额急剧上升。我们利用这些初步结果，提出了关于金融如何影响创新方向性的新研究问题，以及这对可再生能源政策的启示。
